title: Temporal Ambiguity in Settlement Schedule
description: Tests discovery of unmeasurable temporal requirements using vague phrasing ('periodically throughout the day', 'after a while') lacking explicit frequencies or deadlines.

expectedRequirements.statementPattern: .*reconciliation worker runs periodically throughout the day.*

expectedFindings.rationale: Settlement execution and ledger synchronization rely on ambiguous temporal phrases ('periodically throughout the day', 'after a while') with no concrete cron schedule, SLA window, or completion timeout.
